evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition frames self-origination and possession of capability as the appealed-to good, appealing to autonomy and achievement-standing simultaneously.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Framing perspective as a kept asset appeals to autonomy (self-origination) and self-enhancement (holding what is valuable) in the same owned-intelligence move.
